**1 issue found** across 2 files Confidence score: **4/5** - In `tests/otel_integrations/test_openai.py`, the fixture emits a usage-only chunk without requesting `include_usage`, so this test misses ordinary streams and models an impossible response. Align the fixture with a normal stream or request usage explicitly.
Prompt for AI agents (unresolved issues) ```text Check if these issues are valid — if so, understand the root cause of each and fix them. When an issue isn't valid or won't be fixed in this PR, reply in its thread with the reason and then resolve the thread. If appropriate, use sub-agents to investigate and fix each issue separately. P2: This fixture always emits the usage-only chunk even though `test_completions_stream` does not request `include_usage`, so the test no longer covers ordinary streams without usage and models an impossible response. Gate the chunk on `stream_options['include_usage']` and retain a no-usage case. ```
Reply with feedback, questions, or to request a fix.

What changed in this PR Brings legacy OpenAI completion streams in line with other Logfire integrations by recording response metadata and token usage. **Changes:** - Captures response ID, served model, per-choice finish reasons, and usage. - Emits usage and cost attributes through the existing helper. - Extends regression coverage for final usage chunks and empty metadata. | File | Description | | ---- | ----------- | | tests/​otel_integrations/​test_openai.py | Adds usage-chunk coverage, snapshot updates, and an empty-metadata test. | | logfire-sdk/​logfire/​_internal/​integrations/​llm_providers/​openai.py | Accumulates and exports streamed completion metadata and usage. |
